title: Pull Requests (PRs) & Code Reviews
introduction: Today you learn the heartbeat of modern software engineering: **Pull Requests (PRs)**. A Pull Request is not just code — it is an invitation for your team to review, discuss, test, and approve your changes before merging them into production.
why_it_matters: Code review is where junior developers learn fastest and where teams catch bugs before users ever see them. Knowing how to write a clear PR description and constructively participate in code reviews is what separates amateur coders from hireable software engineers.
practical_activity_preview: Push a feature branch to GitHub, open a descriptive Pull Request, inspect diffs, and merge it.
